wins: Established consistent reconnaissance flow to enumerate exposed services and open ports within single episode.
Maintained structured documentation of each mentor call, enabling quick reference for remediation steps.
fails: Unable to complete privilege escalation phase, resulting in zero success rate despite full run completion.
Exceeded mentor call budget (10 calls) without resolving core exploitation block, indicating insufficient follow-up automation.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase is repeatable, but efforts consistently break down during privilege escalation, leaving exploitation incomplete.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts repeatedly failed due to missing local administrator credentials and lack of lateral movement.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts and record supported auth methods

skill_cards.if_condition: When local services expose outdated binaries
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke vulnerability scanner for known privilege escalation paths and log findings

skill_cards.if_condition: After initial user compromise without admin rights
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate scheduled tasks and startup scripts to identify persistence or credential sources

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success identifying active SSH services and auth schemes during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Targeted privilege escalation automation
next_experiments.description: Script credential harvesting from scheduled tasks and service configs after user compromise to feed into escalation routines.

next_experiments.title: Hybrid persistence and lateral cueing
